author: GavinNewsom
text:
SCOTUS has REJECTED Trump’s plan to change mail-in voting and rig the elections before the midterms.

Mail-in voting is safe and accessible. In California, ballots are sent to all registered voters the first week of October.

Let’s show up this November and take Congress back!
